summary: Quiet unsigned kerb under trees; homes 17-21 m away on the north side.

best_section.where: Seventh Avenue north kerb, lower bend under the trees below the junction

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwellings 17 m to 21 m from the section on its own side; treed frontage screens the house above.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; a few cars parked at the lower end and the junction, so room to stop exists.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, light local traffic.
drivers.convention: No signs; a couple of cars park along the nearby kerb.

flags: Dense tree cover, drips and leaf litter likely
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the whole section, shading it from the south and west.
